format: Perl/Assembly hybrid (ARM assembly with embedded Perl code)
description: This file contains an ARM assembly implementation of the modular inverse function using the Binary Extended GCD algorithm, with embedded Perl code generating the assembly. It is part of the BoringSSL cryptography library, specifically for the P-256 elliptic curve.

methods.name: TEST_B_ZERO
methods.description: Checks if the B register is zero, used in the extended Euclidean algorithm.

methods.name: SHIFT1
methods.description: Shifts a multi-word register right by one, adding the modulus if the least significant bit is set.

methods.name: SHIFT256
methods.description: Performs a variable right shift on four 64-bit words, combining shifts with different amounts.
